description: This source file defines a static class 'InaccessibleSerializableTypeDiagnostic' containing diagnostic rule constants and a method to create diagnostics related to accessibility issues of serializable types in source generation for the Orleans framework.

classes.name: InaccessibleSerializableTypeDiagnostic
classes.description: A static class providing diagnostic rules and a method to generate diagnostics related to inaccessible serializable types.

methods.name: CreateDiagnostic
methods.description: Creates a Diagnostic object indicating that a serializable type is inaccessible from generated code, using the provided symbol.
